claim: On November 15, 2022 the AppFlow documentation history added that any flow that transfers data to Amazon S3 can catalog the data so you can discover and access it from AWS analytics and machine learning services, and organize the data into partitions and files.
question: Since when can AppFlow catalog its output in the AWS Glue Data Catalog?

qualifiers.scope: flows that transfer data to Amazon S3

note: d033. The What's New feed dates the Glue Data Catalog integration 2022-11-17; the history row says November 15, 2022. Current-truth page: flows-catalog (registers metadata tables in the AWS Glue Data Catalog).
